declare void @throw_exception()

declare i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

declare ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr)

declare void @__cxa_end_catch()

define void @test1() personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  invoke void @throw_exception()
          to label %try.cont unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %0 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          catch ptr null
  %1 = extractvalue { ptr, i32 } %0, 0
  %2 = tail call ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr %1)
  tail call void @__cxa_end_catch()
  br label %try.cont

try.cont:                                         ; preds = %lpad, %entry
  ret void
}

define <2 x i32> @test_pasubu_w(<2 x i32> %a, <2 x i32> %b) {
  %a_ext = zext <2 x i32> %a to <2 x i64>
  %b_ext = zext <2 x i32> %b to <2 x i64>
  %sub = sub <2 x i64> %a_ext, %b_ext
  %res = lshr <2 x i64> %sub, splat (i64 1)
  %res_trunc = trunc <2 x i64> %res to <2 x i32>
  ret <2 x i32> %res_trunc
}

define i1 @widen_anyof_rdx(ptr %p, i64 %n) {
entry:
  br label %loop

loop:                                             ; preds = %loop, %entry
  %iv = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop ]
  %phi = phi <vscale x 4 x i1> [ zeroinitializer, %entry ], [ %rec, %loop ]
  %avl = sub i64 %n, %iv
  %evl = call i32 @llvm.experimental.get.vector.length.i64(i64 %avl, i32 4, i1 true)
  %gep = getelementptr i32, ptr %p, i64 %iv
  %x = call <vscale x 4 x i32> @llvm.vp.load.nxv4i32.p0(ptr %gep, <vscale x 4 x i1> splat (i1 true), i32 %evl)
  %cmp = icmp ne <vscale x 4 x i32> %x, zeroinitializer
  %rec = call <vscale x 4 x i1> @llvm.vp.merge.nxv4i1(<vscale x 4 x i1> %cmp, <vscale x 4 x i1> splat (i1 true), <vscale x 4 x i1> %phi, i32 %evl)
  %evl.zext = zext i32 %evl to i64
  %iv.next = add i64 %iv, %evl.zext
  %done = icmp sge i64 %iv.next, %n
  br i1 %done, label %exit, label %loop

exit:                                             ; preds = %loop
  %res = call i1 @llvm.vector.reduce.or.nxv4i1(<vscale x 4 x i1> %rec)
  ret i1 %res
}

define void @ashr_32bytes_wordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %wordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %A = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 false, ptr %A, align 1
  %L = load i1, ptr %A, align 1
  br i1 %L, label %T, label %F

  %bitOff = shl i256 %wordOff, 5
  %res = ashr i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  ret void

T:                                                ; preds = %T, %0
  br i1 %L, label %BB, label %T

F:                                                ; preds = %0
  br label %BB
}

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @shl_32bytes_wordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %wordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %A = alloca i256, align 8
  store i256 poison, ptr %A, align 4
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %wordOff = load i256, ptr %wordOff.ptr, align 1
  %bitOff = shl i256 %wordOff, 5
  %res = shl i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i256 %src, ptr %A, align 4
  ret void
}

  store i128 0, ptr %A, align 4
  tail call void @llvm.memset.inline.p0.i64(ptr %a, i8 0, i64 64, i1 false)
  %L = load i128, ptr %A, align 4
  switch i128 %L, label %SW_D [
    i128 10773959786756295042, label %SW_C
    i128 1905842551333371031, label %SW_C1
    i128 8186122156717221736, label %SW_C2
  ]

BB:                                               ; preds = %SW_C2, %SW_C1, %SW_C, %SW_D
  ret void

SW_D:                                             ; preds = %SW_D, %0
  %L4 = load i1, ptr %A3, align 1
  br i1 %L4, label %BB, label %SW_D

SW_C:                                             ; preds = %0
  br label %BB

SW_C1:                                            ; preds = %0
  br label %BB

SW_C2:                                            ; preds = %0
  br label %BB
}
